highlight: Low time, fresh Phase A-D & 12-year, Engines enrolled on MSP Gold.
overview:
This 2001 Learjet 31A has 5,923 total hours and 4,497 cycles, with both Honeywell TFE731-2-3B engines on MSP Gold. Fresh out of a Phase A–D and 12-year inspection completed December 2025 by Intercontinental Jet Services Corp.

Equipped with Raisbeck ZR LITE, aft fuselage locker, winglets, and Dee Howard TR-4000 thrust reversers. The panel includes Universal UNS-1E FMS, 5-tube EFIS-50, dual Garmin GTX3000 transponders, GDL88 ADS-B Out, TCAS II, and RVSM. The eight-passenger cabin features grey leather with a mid-cabin club and aft 3-place divan, belted forward lavatory, and 110-volt outlets. Based in San Antonio, TX.
